definition_quote.value: The 'practice of optometry' means any one or combination of the following practices: examining the human eyes and visual system, diagnosing and correcting anomalies of the refractive and functional ability of the visual system, prescribing appropriate pharmaceutical agents, removing superficial foreign bodies, and managing certain types of glaucoma.
definition_quote.quote: The "practice of optometry" means any one or combination of the following practices

value: examining the human eyes and visual system for diagnosis of refractive and functional ability
diagnosing eye and adnexa disease or injury and treating with pharmaceutical agents and procedures
prescribing and using ophthalmic lenses, prisms, autorefractor or other automatic testing devices, frames, ophthalmic aids, and prosthetic materials
administering visual training, vision therapy, orthoptics, and pleoptics
prescribing pharmaceutical agents for diagnosis, management, and treatment of the eye and adnexa
removing superficial foreign bodies from the eye and adnexa
epilating the eyelashes, including by electrolysis
punctal dilation, lacrimal irrigation, and punctal plugs insertion
managing specified types of glaucoma in patients 16 years of age or older
methods_authorized.quote: Examining the human eyes and visual system for purposes of: diagnosing refractive and functional ability; or diagnosing the presence of eye and adnexa disease or injury, treating the disease or injury with the appropriate pharmaceutical agents and procedures

drug_authority.value: Prescribing appropriate pharmaceutical agents for the diagnosis, management, and treatment of the eye and adnexa, including oral therapeutic pharmaceutical agents
drug_authority.quote: Prescribing appropriate pharmaceutical agents for the diagnosis, management, and treatment of the eye and adnexa.

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: Removing superficial foreign bodies from the eye and adnexa

value: epilating the eyelashes, including by electrolysis
minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: epilating the eyelashes, including by electrolysis; and punctal dilation, lacrimal irrigation, and punctal plugs insertion.

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: Managing the following types of glaucoma in patients who are 16 years of age or older

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: administering visual training, vision therapy, orthoptics, and pleoptics.

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: A licensee who employs an oral therapeutic pharmaceutical agent that might prove to have significant systemic adverse reactions or systemic side effects

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: Prescribing appropriate pharmaceutical agents for the diagnosis, management, and treatment of the eye and adnexa.

referral_to_physician_required.quote: If a glaucoma patient does not respond to up to three topically administered pharmaceutical agents within a reasonable time, the licensee shall refer the patient to a licensed ophthalmologist.

comanagement_with_ophthalmologist_requir.quote: If an oral medication is required to obtain an adequate clinical response in a glaucoma patient, the licensee shall consult with a licensed ophthalmologist as soon as clinically prudent following initiation of the oral medication.

contact_lens_prescription_expiration_yea.quote: The expiration date shall be one year after the examination date unless a medical or refractive problem affecting vision requires an earlier expiration date.

spectacle_prescription_release_required.quote: Failure to comply with prescription-released requirements established in the Federal Ophthalmic Practice Rule (16 C.F.R. Part 456) or the Fairness to Contact Lens Consumers Act (15 U.S.C.A. § 7601-7610).
